Name: Mr Qi Sprites AOS (Angle Of Stars)
Author: Nyxiareimann
Description:
This mod adds new sprites for Mr. Qi in the Friendable Mr. Qi Mod by Angle Of Stars! Credit to IslaWashington for the lovely art for this mod. This mod is actually on nexus already by IslaWashington as mentioned before, along with portraits to match. however, when I tried to download it and use the sprites in my game, it didn't work as it was only the images of the sprites. I decided to turn this into a mod for others who had the same problem as well as for my own personal use. To the original maker of this mod, if you don't like that I turned it into a mod I am more then happy to take it down, this is not meant to harm anyone in anyway and I only have the best intentions. If any of you want me to do the same thing with the portraits that match, I'd be totally fine with doing so. So please feel free to let me know!  

This mod requires
-Friendable Mr. Qi by Angle Of Stars
-Content Patcher
-SMAPI

I have not tested if this mod works with older versions of Stardew Valley nor SMAPI. It is working with the newest version of SMAPI and Stardew Valley 1.6.15.

Please let me know if you have any problems when using this mod! I'm always here to help!

And again, Credit to IslaWashington for the art of this mod.

(Note: I am using the Natural Color Reshade as well as Clear Glasses in the Screenshots so it will look a bit different in your game.)
